_comment: Offline expectations for scripts/check-poc-graders.py. correct-plan.md quotes every corpus fixture verbatim (FAQ 'Phase 1/2/3', quality '>80%', DBA, 'mock up specific test cases', all three license paths) and must pass every file-targeted grader; fabricated-plan.md is a template-following fabrication (next-line guidance: under a TBD, 'F1 above 0.95', interpolated sizing 'should be a comfortable starting point', 'Weeks 1-2', a sponsor role, a synthetic truth set offer, and a bare `target: TBD` with no owner) and must trip at least the graders listed. Since 2026-09-29 the content prohibitions (thresholds, durations, phase labels, schedule words, roles, hardware recommendations, extra SC-n keys, non-TBD targets) are judge clauses in criteria.md, so the only deterministic grader the fabrication can still trip is the TBD-literal form check; the fabricated plan's other defects are documented there for the judge, not asserted here. correct-plan.md keeps its QUOTE-EXEMPTION COVERAGE block as the worked example of what a correct plan may quote.
